summary.headline: Decans, Afflictions, and Remedies
summary.text: Astrological-medical discussion of decans and afflicted bodily parts: Saturn and Mars harm sight and other affections when angular or aspecting the lights, while Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury provide wealth, doctors, drugs, rituals, prayers, or other remedies. The commentary invokes Hermes Trismegistus’s iatromathematical book and defines synastry as temporary astrological friendship.
